deals.title: Apple AirTag 4-Pack for $70 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: At Amazon, this 4-pack of Apple AirTag 2nd Generation trackers is $29 off the $99 regular price. That works out to about $17 per tracker. The speaker is 50% louder than the original AirTag, and the upgraded chips extend finding range. Shipping is free. Buy Now at Amazon Features Track items via Find My app Precision finding on iPhone and Apple Watch 50% louder speaker for easy detection Share item location securely with trusted contacts Replaceable battery lasting over one year

deals.title: 2nd-Gen. Refurb Apple AirPods w/ Charging Case for $85 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: These 2nd-generation Apple AirPods are down to $85 in Excellent refurbished condition today at Best Buy. It's the best deal we've seen for these AirPods and $10 cheaper than Amazon's price for a refurbished pair. The Excellent condition means there's minimal visible wear, and a 90-day warranty is included. Shipping is free. Buy Now at Best Buy Features up to 24-hour listening time in-ear detection automatic switching dual mics

My Best Buy members get free shipping on all orders (it's free to join). It comes with a 90-day warranty. The Windows 11 laptop includes a 1-year Microsoft 365 Personal subscription with 1TB of cloud storage and a 720p HD webcam. My Best Buy members get free shipping on all orders (it's free to join). deals.title: MSI MAG Coreliquid A13 240 240mm AIO Liquid CPU Cooler for $50 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: At Newegg, this MSI MAG Coreliquid A13 240 liquid cooler is $49.99 with free shipping. It's the best price we found by $15. The fans come pre-installed and the Intel mounting bracket is already attached, and MSI backs it with a 5-year parts and labor warranty. Shipping is free. Buy Now at Newegg Features 240mm aluminum radiator w/ two pre-installed 120mm ARGB fans Fan speed of 500 to 2000 RPM w/ 62.6 CFM airflow and 31.1 dBA noise Pump runs at 3800 RPM w/ 20 dBA average noise Fits Intel LGA 1700/1851 & AMD AM4/AM5 sockets 15.35" EPDM tubing resists coolant evaporation 5-year limited warranty on parts and labor

deals.title: Blink Outdoor 2K+ 5-Camera Wireless Security System w/ Battery Doorbell 2K+ & Sync Module Core for $120 + free shipping w/ Prime
deals.sourceText: At Amazon, this Blink 2K+ bundle is 71% off. The $120 price hits its Amazon all-time low and sits below its 90-day average of $270. The kit pairs the Battery Doorbell 2K+ with Outdoor 2K+ cameras and a Sync Module Core. Shipping is free. Buy Now at Amazon Features Five Outdoor 2K+ cameras plus one Battery Doorbell 2K+ bundle with Sync Module Core included 2K video resolution with 4x zoom Color night vision that switches to black & white in near darkness IP-65 weather-resistant design for rain & dust Battery powered with included AA Energizer lithium batteries Person & vehicle alerts available w/ optional Blink Subscription Plan (sold separately)

deals.title: Onkyo TX-NR7100 9.2-Channel AV Receiver for $750 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: The Onkyo TX-NR7100 is $650 off at Amazon. Its nine amplified channels can be set up as 7.1.2 or 5.1.4 Dolby Atmos speaker layouts, and each channel is rated at 100 watts. Bluetooth also works in both directions, so the receiver can send audio to wireless headphones. Shipping is free. Buy Now at Amazon Features Dirac Live automatic room acoustic calibration 9-channel 8K/4K high-speed HDMI processing Seamless integration with Sonos Home Sound System HDMI 2.1 gaming with 4K/120Hz and VRR Immersive Dolby Atmos and DTS:X audio

deals.title: AceMagic M5 Core 5 220H Mini PC w/ 16GB RAM & 512GB SSD for $466 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: This ACEMAGIC M5 mini PC is priced at $466 when you click on the brand promotion coupon on the product page and proceed to checkout. That's a new Amazon all-time low and sits far below its 90-day average of $810. It includes 16GB of memory and a 512GB SSD, with two storage slots that support up to 4TB total. It can drive up to three 4K displays at 60Hz. Shipping is free. Buy Now at Amazon Features Intel Core 5 220H processor, up to 4.9GHz 16GB LPDDR5 memory and 512GB NVMe SSD Two M.2 slots support up to 4TB total storage Supports up to three 4K 60Hz displays via HDMI, DisplayPort, and USB-C 6 USB-A ports, USB-C, Gigabit Ethernet, WiFi 6, Bluetooth 5.2 5" x 5" chassis with dual-fan cooling

deals.title: AceMagic K1 Ryzen 5 5425U Mini PC for $296 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: The ACEMAGIC K1 mini PC drops to $296 when you clip the coupon and the promotion on the product page, then proceed to checkout. That's $74 off and a new all-time low. It includes 16GB of RAM and a 512GB SSD, and a second storage slot allows expansion up to 4TB. Windows 11 Pro comes preinstalled, and the unit supports up to three 4K displays. Shipping is free. Buy Now at Amazon Features AMD Ryzen 5 5425U processor with speeds up to 4.1GHz 16GB RAM & 512GB SSD with a second slot for expansion up to 4TB Windows 11 Pro preinstalled Supports up to three 4K displays via HDMI, DisplayPort, and USB-C Six USB 3.2 ports, Wi-Fi 5, Bluetooth 4.2, & Gigabit Ethernet Measures 5 x 5 x 1.6" and weighs 1.25 lbs. w/ included VESA mount

deals.title: TP-Link Kasa Smart Outdoor WiFi Plug for $17 + free shipping w/ Prime
deals.sourceText: At Amazon, get this TP-Link Kasa Smart Outdoor WiFi Plug for $17. It's the best deal we've seen for this model. Its two outlets can be controlled independently, and it works with Apple HomeKit, Alexa, and Google Assistant without a hub. Apple HomeKit remote control requires a HomePod or Apple TV at home. Shipping is free for Prime members. Buy Now at Amazon Features Apple HomeKit, Alexa & Google Assistant compatible WiFi range up to 300'
